notes: Quests the game offers that tarkov.dev doesn't list yet, written in its own task shape so every build step treats them alike. Edited by hand; the build says when tarkov.dev has caught up, so the entry can go.
The id must be the real one from a logged start, or log tracking can't match the quest. Never record player-specific details here (profile IDs, dates, progress).

To the Light - Trust but Verify: id from a logged Mechanic start (checked 2026-11-03). Objectives from the in-game screen, rewards and trader levels from the wiki. The stash position is the wiki's marked map fitted onto our Lab labels, so it's approximate; tarkov.dev's weapon testing zone landed where that map draws the room. The game labels the extract optional but its text says it's needed to complete the quest, so it's required here.

quests.name: To the Light - Trust but Verify

objectives.description: Stash the Hard drive with false data in the server room near the weapon testing area (in one raid)
After stashing the drive, extract through the Ventilation Shaft (in one raid)
